normative_provenance.candidate_terminology_policy: S-C01 candidate terminology is non-normative and absent from every draft cell.

field_scope.acceptance_gate: Final use is prohibited until a healthy dedicated browser gate permits current visible Advanced Search field inventory, exact query echo/rewrite behavior, and one-field operand semantics. P02 made no Wiley request because its required endpoint check was stale.

source_native_draft.term_rendering: Every finite dictionary literal is preserved as one double-quoted atom; fully parenthesized AND/OR groups are unvalidated Wiley syntax candidates.
source_native_draft.phrase_policy: Quoted multiword strings are draft ordered-phrase candidates only; phrase/token/punctuation/hyphen behavior is untested.
source_native_draft.parser_status: P02 regenerated the exact v4 expressions and verified the corrected adapter's source-free no-clobber suite, but made no Wiley request after the required dedicated endpoint check reported stale. AND/OR/NOT, precedence, phrase, punctuation, acronym, case, wildcard, expansion, proximity, length, fields, and echo/rewrite remain untested.

paired_term_handling.normative_requirement: Every left/right pair is unordered, in one searchable field, with at most five intervening lexical tokens.
paired_term_handling.draft_transport: Every required left/right cross-product is rendered as a separate parenthesized Boolean conjunction, which is broader than the required proximity relation.
paired_term_handling.why: No current Wiley-native proximity operator, distance semantics, or same-field operand behavior was observed. An aggregate Anywhere route could cross underlying fields, so this draft cannot claim an exact or compliant same-field fallback.
paired_term_handling.future_gate: Validate a Wiley-native unordered <=5-token operator or document and prove a broader same-field construction that cannot lose an exact pair; apply the exact rule locally wherever retained fields permit.
